## Skill purpose

What problem does it solve, in one or two sentences?

## Trigger conditions

When should an agent invoke this skill? Exact phrases, situations, task types.

## Proposed workflow

Numbered outline of the steps the agent should follow.

## Target agents

Which agent tools is this written for (e.g. OpenCode, or any SKILL.md-compatible harness)?

## Provenance and license

Is this skill entirely your own work, or inspired by an external skill? If
external material influenced it, link the source and state its license. Do not
paste third-party code unless its license permits redistribution.

## Validation done

- [ ] Frontmatter follows `docs/SKILL_SPEC.md` and `docs/templates/SKILL-TEMPLATE.md`
- [ ] `python scripts/validate-frontmatter.py` passes
- [ ] Trigger conditions are explicit and testable
- [ ] No secrets, private paths or personal data

## Additional context
